title: Read, Parse, Describe: Unified Document Parsing with Visual Element Description Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.20335v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Document understanding systems are typically evaluated as separate components via layout analysis, optical text recognition, reading-order prediction, and image captioning. This separation leaves scientific figures, captions, and visual semantics weakly connected, and fails to measure whether a model can produce a single page-level parse that is both structurally faithful and semantically accessible. We introduce Read-Parse-Describe, a unified dataset for document parsing with visual element description generation. Given a page image, models are required to output an ordered list of layout elements containing bounding boxes, semantic labels, reading-order indices, recognized textual content, and alternative text descriptions for visual elements. translated_title: 阅读、解析、描述：基于视觉元素描述生成的统一文档解析
translated_abstract: 文档理解系统通常作为独立组件进行评估，包括版面分析、光学文字识别、阅读顺序预测和图像描述生成。这种分离使得科学图表、图注和视觉语义之间的联系较为薄弱，并且无法衡量模型能否生成既结构忠实又语义可访问的单一页级解析结果。我们提出了 Read-Parse-Describe，一个用于文档解析与视觉元素描述生成的统一数据集。给定一张页面图像，模型需要输出一个有序的版面元素列表，其中包含边界框、语义标签、阅读顺序索引、识别出的文本内容以及视觉元素的替代文本描述。该基准基于2,402份文档构建，包含18,163个连续页面、125,218个版面元素和11,338个视觉实例。此外，我们还进一步提出了一种即插即用的空间（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出了 Read-Parse-Describe，一个将版面分析、文本识别、阅读顺序预测与视觉元素描述生成整合为单一页级解析任务的统一文档解析基准，涵盖2,402份文档、125,218个版面元素和11,338个视觉实例。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Read-Parse-Describe, a unified document parsing benchmark that integrates layout analysis, text recognition, reading-order prediction, and visual element description generation into a single page-level parsing task, built from 2,402 documents with 125,218 layout elements and 11,338 visual instances.
